evidence: The films had polycrystalline cubic In O structure with the w100 xdirection as the strongest orientation as typical for the ALD deposited nondoped and doped In O w2,11x. In the film made with the highest doping ratio, the structure studied by XRD was not homogenous. The four of the most intense reflections of the cubic ZrO2 phase, (111 ), (200 ), (220 ) and (311 ), are strongly overlapping with the four strongest reflections of the cubic In O phase: (222 ), (400 ), (440 ) and (622 ).
